title: Software Support Executive (Mandarin Speaker)
job_description:
Diploma or Degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field. Good communication skills in English and Bahasa Malaysia. Mandarin speaking is a must as the role requires supporting many Mandarin-speaking customers. Knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server or MySQL is an advantage. Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-oriented attitude. Able to work independently and as part of a team. Fresh graduates and internship candidates are encouraged to apply.

Provide application support to customers via phone, email, WhatsApp, and remote access. Troubleshoot issues related to EasySales mobile apps, web portals, and system synchronization. Record and follow up on customer inquiries, issues, and support requests. Conduct basic user training and assist customers in using the system. Escalate technical issues and bugs to the development team when necessary. Perform ad-hoc tasks assigned by team leaders. Benefits Full-stocked pantry with coffee, tea, biscuits, snacks, and beverages. Freshly ground coffee from our semi-automatic coffee machine. Medical and dental benefits. Gym membership subsidy. Smart casual working attire. Festive celebrations and birthday celebrations. Bi-monthly sports activities Yearly company trip. Friendly and supportive working environment. Opportunities for learning, growth, and career development.

EPF SOCSO Annual Leave Medical Leave Health Insurance EIS Annual Bonus Allowance Provided Company Trip 5 Working Days

Customer Support Technical Support Software Troubleshooting IT Support Communication Skills
